# ข้อ1 

## Data : BankChurners 
## Class Variable : Attrition Flag
```{r}
bank <- read.csv('BankChurners.csv')
table(bank$Attrition_Flag)
str(factor(bank$Attrition_Flag))
```


### "ยัด data ทั้งหมด(ให้ y = Attrition Flag (ปรับเป็น factor variable โดยที่ Existing = 1 Attrited = 0) x = ทุกตัวแปรที่เหลือยกเว้น CLIENTNUM) เข้า model ดูเทียบค่า P-value ตรวจสอบว่าว่าค่าใดควรอยู่ในตัวแบบ"

```{r}
library(base)

bank <- bank[2:length(bank)]

number <- dim(bank)[1] 
bank$Attrition_Flag <- factor(bank$Attrition_Flag, levels = c("Attrited Customer","Existing Customer"))

summary(glm(Attrition_Flag~. ,data = bank, family = 'binomial'))


```


### "จากการพิจารณา P-value ทำให้ตัวแปรสุทธิที่จะถูกคัดเลือกคือ 
### y = Attrition_flag

### x1 = Gender, 
### x2 = Dependent_count
### x3 =Income_Category
### x4 = Total_Relationship_Count
### x5 = Months_Inactive_12_mon
### x6 = Contacts_Count_12_mon 
### x7 = Total_Revolving_Bal
### x8 = Total_Trans_Amt
### x9 = Total_Trans_Ct


### "ทำ Monte แบ่ง Data หาจุดตัว prob ที่ดีที่สุด และ หา Average Accuracy"

```{r}
monte_acc <- seq(20)
each_threshold <- seq(0.1,0.9,by = 0.1)

tp_each_monte <- seq(20)
tn_each_monte <- seq(20)
fp_each_monte <- seq(20)
fn_each_monte <- seq(20)

pre_each_monte <- seq(20)
rec_each_monte <- seq(20)

f_1_each_monte <- seq(20)

for (i in 1:20){
  for_train <- sample(number, size = (0.8 * number),replace = FALSE)
  for (j in 1:length(each_threshold)){
    fin_model <- glm(Attrition_Flag ~ 
                       Gender + Dependent_count + Income_Category +
                       Total_Relationship_Count + Months_Inactive_12_mon + Contacts_Count_12_mon + Total_Revolving_Bal + Total_Trans_Amt + Total_Trans_Ct,
                     data = bank, subset = for_train, family = 'binomial' )
    fin_prob <- predict(fin_model, newdata = bank[-for_train,], type = 'response')
    
    fin_pred <- rep("Attrited Customer",length(fin_prob))
    fin_pred[fin_prob > (j/10)] = "Existing Customer"
    
    each_threshold[j] = mean(fin_pred == bank[-for_train, ]$Attrition_Flag)
  }
  fin_prob <- predict(fin_model, newdata = bank[-for_train,], type = 'response')
  fin_pred <- rep("Attrited Customer",length(fin_prob))
  fin_pred[fin_prob > (which.max(each_threshold)/10)] = "Existing Customer"
  
  monte_acc[i] =  mean(fin_pred == bank[-for_train, ]$Attrition_Flag)
  
  fin_table <- table(fin_pred, bank[-for_train, ]$Attrition_Flag)
  tp_each_monte[i] <- fin_table[2,2]
  tn_each_monte[i] <- fin_table[1,1]
  fp_each_monte[i] <- fin_table[2,1]
  fn_each_monte[i] <- fin_table[1,2]
  
  pre_each_monte[i] <- tp_each_monte[i]/(tp_each_monte[i]+fp_each_monte[i])
  rec_each_monte[i] <- tp_each_monte[i]/(tp_each_monte[i]+fn_each_monte[i])
  
  f_1_each_monte[i] <- 2*(pre_each_monte[i] * rec_each_monte[i])/(pre_each_monte[i] + rec_each_monte[i])
}

```


### "จากการทำ Monte 20 รอบ ที่ train st = 80% ได้ค่าเป็น"

### Discriminant Line

```{r include=FALSE}

np <- 500
sep_length <- seq(from = seq(from = min(iris$Sepal.Length), to = max(iris$Sepal.Length), length.out = np))
sep_width <- seq(from = seq(from = min(iris$Sepal.Width), to = max(iris$Sepal.Width), , length.out = np))
pet_length <- seq(from = seq(from = min(iris$Petal.Length), to = max(iris$Petal.Length), length.out = np))
pet_width <- seq(from = seq(from = min(iris$Petal.Width), to = max(iris$Petal.Width), , length.out = np))

nd_1_2 <- expand.grid(Sepal.Length = sep_length, Sepal.Width = sep_width)
nd_1_3 <- expand.grid(Sepal.Length = sep_length, Petal.Length = pet_length)
nd_1_4 <- expand.grid(Sepal.Length = sep_length, Petal.Width = pet_width)
nd_2_3 <- expand.grid(Sepal.Width = sep_width, Petal.Length = pet_length)
nd_2_4 <- expand.grid(Sepal.Width = sep_width, Petal.Width = pet_width)
nd_3_4 <- expand.grid(Petal.Length = pet_length, Petal.Width = pet_width)


prd_1_2 <- as.numeric(predict(multinom(Species~Sepal.Length + Sepal.Width, data = iris),newdata = nd_1_2))
prd_1_3 <- as.numeric(predict(multinom(Species~Sepal.Length + Petal.Length, data = iris),newdata = nd_1_3))
prd_1_4 <- as.numeric(predict(multinom(Species~Sepal.Length + Petal.Width, data = iris),newdata = nd_1_4))

prd_2_3 <- as.numeric(predict(multinom(Species~Sepal.Width + Petal.Length, data = iris),newdata = nd_2_3))
prd_2_4 <- as.numeric(predict(multinom(Species~Sepal.Width + Petal.Width, data = iris),newdata = nd_2_4))

prd_3_4 <- as.numeric(predict(multinom(Species~Petal.Length + Petal.Width, data = iris),newdata = nd_3_4))
```

## ข้อ 2.2
### "Monte Carlo 20 รอบ ด้วย train_data = 80%"
```{r include=FALSE}

n <- dim(iris)[1]

model.acc = seq(20)

model.pre.c1 = seq(20)
model.pre.c2 = seq(20)
model.pre.c3 = seq(20)

model.rec.c1 = seq(20)
model.rec.c2 = seq(20)
model.rec.c3 = seq(20)

for (i in 1:length(model.acc)){
  iris_train_index <- sample(n, size = (0.8*n))
  model_iris <- multinom(Species~. ,data = iris, subset = iris_train_index, HESS = TRUE)
  
  iris_probs <- predict(model_iris, newdata = iris[-iris_train_index, ], type = 'probs')
  iris_pred <- predict(model_iris, newdata = iris[-iris_train_index, ], type = 'class')
  
  iris_table <- table(iris_pred,iris$Species[-iris_train_index])
  
  iris_acc <- mean(iris$Species[-iris_train_index] == iris_pred)
  
  model.acc[i] = iris_acc
  model.pre.c1[i] = iris_table[1,1]/(iris_table[1,1]+iris_table[1,2]+iris_table[1,3])
  model.pre.c2[i] = iris_table[2,2]/(iris_table[2,1]+iris_table[2,2]+iris_table[2,3])
  model.pre.c3[i] = iris_table[3,3]/(iris_table[3,1]+iris_table[3,2]+iris_table[3,3])
  
  model.rec.c1[i] = iris_table[1,1]/(iris_table[1,1]+iris_table[2,1]+iris_table[3,1])
  model.rec.c2[i] = iris_table[2,2]/(iris_table[1,2]+iris_table[2,2]+iris_table[3,2])
  model.rec.c3[i] = iris_table[3,3]/(iris_table[1,3]+iris_table[2,3]+iris_table[3,3])
}
```

# ข้อ 2.3
### "ทำ Monte 20 รอบ แล้ว หา Average Accuracy ของแต่ละระดับค่า K"
```{r include=FALSE}
library(class)
library(KODAMA)

iris_knn_acc = matrix(seq(1:100), ncol = 2)
colnames(iris_knn_acc) <- c("K", "Avg Accuracy")
iris_knn_monte = seq(20)

plot(iris[, 1:4], col = iris$Species )

for (i in 1:length(iris_knn_acc[ ,2])){
  iris_knn_acc[i, 1] = i
  for (j in 1:length(iris_knn_monte)){
    iris_train_index <- sample(n, size = (0.8*n))
    
    iris_knn <- knn(iris[iris_train_index, -ncol(iris)], iris[-iris_train_index,-ncol(iris)], 
                  cl = iris[iris_train_index, ]$Species,k = i)
  
    iris_knn_monte[j] <- mean(iris[-iris_train_index, ]$Species == iris_knn)
    iris_knn_acc[i,2] <- mean(iris_knn_monte)
 }
}
```

### "Average Accuracy แต่ละระดับค่า K"
```{r}
iris_knn_acc
plot(iris_knn_acc)
```

### "ค่า K ที่ Average Accuracy มากที่สุด"
```{r}
best_k <- which.max(iris_knn_acc[ ,2])
best_k
```

## "ทำ KNN คู่ กับ Monte train data 80%
## ด้วยค่า K ที่ทำให้ได้ Average Accuracy มากที่สุด" 

```{r include=FALSE}
n <- dim(iris)[1]

knn.model.acc = seq(20)

knn.model.pre.c1 = seq(20)
knn.model.pre.c2 = seq(20)
knn.model.pre.c3 = seq(20)

knn.model.rec.c1 = seq(20)
knn.model.rec.c2 = seq(20)
knn.model.rec.c3 = seq(20)

for (i in 1:length(knn.model.acc)){
  iris_train_index <- sample(n, size = (0.8*n))
  knn_model <- knn(iris[iris_train_index, -ncol(iris)], iris[-iris_train_index,-ncol(iris)], 
                  cl = iris[iris_train_index, ]$Species,k = best_k)
  
  
  knn_model_table <- table(knn_model,iris$Species[-iris_train_index])
  
  knn_model_acc <- mean(iris$Species[-iris_train_index] == knn_model)
  
  knn.model.acc[i] = knn_model_acc
  knn.model.pre.c1[i] = knn_model_table[1,1]/(knn_model_table[1,1]+knn_model_table[1,2]+knn_model_table[1,3])
  knn.model.pre.c2[i] = knn_model_table[2,2]/(knn_model_table[2,1]+knn_model_table[2,2]+knn_model_table[2,3])
  knn.model.pre.c3[i] = knn_model_table[3,3]/(knn_model_table[3,1]+knn_model_table[3,2]+knn_model_table[3,3])
  
  knn.model.rec.c1[i] = knn_model_table[1,1]/(knn_model_table[1,1]+knn_model_table[2,1]+knn_model_table[3,1])
  knn.model.rec.c2[i] = knn_model_table[2,2]/(knn_model_table[1,2]+knn_model_table[2,2]+knn_model_table[3,2])
  knn.model.rec.c3[i] = knn_model_table[3,3]/(knn_model_table[1,3]+knn_model_table[2,3]+knn_model_table[3,3])
}
```
